facts.rationale: Preserves the supported guards and non-idempotence warning while correcting the unconditional already-destroyed interpretation to include the callee's exceptional deferred branch.
facts.value: Requests destruction of every non-null retained marker GObj, then unconditionally requests destruction of the retained camera GObj. The generic destruction routine asserts a non-null argument and normally releases attachments, processes and render linkage before unlinking and freeing the object, but when its current-process-object deferral condition holds it only sets the pending-destruction flag and returns. This wrapper does not clear retained pointers or explicitly remove SIS text entries, so it establishes neither immediate destruction of every referenced object nor an idempotent, safely repeatable post-teardown state.
